source_evidence: However, like all classes, no-load classes still have ongoing operating costs, such as management fees, transfer agent fees and other operating expenses including, in some cases, 12b-1 fees. In addition, transaction fees may be charged by the broker when buying or selling some no-load share classes.
question: Do retail no-load shares necessarily have zero costs?
answer: No. No-load shares do not have a sales load, but they can still carry ongoing operating expenses, sometimes including 12b-1 fees. A broker may also charge transaction fees when you buy or sell some no-load share classes.
